description: The launching agent earns 15% of creator fees onchain. Creator fees follow trading volume and can be zero. MAINNET custodial launch: Prefer explicit crew[] (from crew_list_kols). Autohire is a fallback convenience. Creates a Pump.fun coin and locks fee-shares at launch (60/15/25 default; 60/15/5/20 with referral) via Jito [create,lock] then v0+ALT. Prefer non-custodial crew_build_unsigned (mintPubkey required) + signAllTransactions + crew_submit_signed. Approval optional; requires CREW_AGENT_API_KEY + CREW_LAUNCHER_KEY. crew_wire_fees is repair-only.

crew.description: Explicit crew (shares must total 100%) overrides Autohire when provided

evmWallet.description: Optional 0x… Base address (42 chars) for Zora/Clanker payouts.

handle.description: X / Pump handle without @. Example: "crewpayhq". Required.

hireRole.description: Optional hire role label. One of caller | chart | raid | kol | dev.

share.description: Integer percent of the crew slice (1–100). Crew shares must total 100.

wallet.description: Solana payout wallet (base58). Required. Example: a KOL wallet from crew_list_kols.

description.description: ≤204 chars; attribution appended to reach ≤240 final

dryRunId.description: Optional unless the API key has requireApproval=true

idempotencyKey.description: Retry-safe key; replays cached launch for 15m

launcherKey.description: FORBIDDEN — rejected if set. Use CREW_LAUNCHER_KEY in MCP env only.

name: crew_launch
title: Launch Pump coin via CrewPay (MAINNET)
